offering_description.value: The company processes in-store and online payments for merchants and helps businesses pay suppliers. It also provides software that lets businesses and fintech platforms manage accounts, hold funds and move money through banking partners.

primary_products.value: Merchant payment gateways; accounts payable automation software; embedded banking and treasury software

primary_services.value: Merchant acquiring and payment processing; supplier payment processing; account administration and funds transfers

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize merchants, corporate finance teams, software providers and fintech platforms

end_markets.value: Retail and e-commerce; restaurants and hospitality; business services; fintech; real estate

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Card acceptance, supplier payments and funds transfers; service fees: Payment platform access and account administration
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes card transactions for merchants and supplier payments for businesses; software / platform: Connects payment networks and banking partners to merchants, finance teams and software platforms; financial intermediary: Facilitates collection, custody and transfer of customer funds through banking partners
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

specialization.value: related lines: Merchant acquiring, supplier payments and embedded finance

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Independent sales organizations, software vendors and financial institutions; direct sales: Sales teams serving businesses and platform operators; online: Self-service signup for supplier payment software

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Money transmission subject to state licensing and federal anti-money-laundering rules

notes: The extent of its current operations outside the United States is uncertain.
